query: fixed-width AAS MRT sat_saga_dr3_tableC4_candidates.mrt parsed on its published byte ranges

extraction.method: byte-range parse of the MRT Byte-by-byte block

measurement_or_model: MIXED. MEASUREMENT: RAdeg, DEdeg, Rhost (projected separation), rmag, gr, sb, ba, PA, Sersic, z, DVhost (line-of-sight velocity offset from the host), all emission-line fluxes and equivalent widths, NUVmag, log(MHI). DERIVED-WITH-ASSUMPTIONS: log(M*), log(sfr)*, quenched flag (stellar-population modelling; no dark matter). NO dark-matter-dependent column is present in this table.
note: SAGA DR3 Table C4 satellite candidates without reliable redshifts.
